# 0.4.0 release plan: Evidence Capture and Paper Draft

Status: planning scaffold for [Experiments #17](https://github.com/cmudrc/design-research-experiments/issues/17) and [#34](https://github.com/cmudrc/design-research-experiments/issues/34) in the coordinated [Study to Evidence to Paper Draft release](https://github.com/cmudrc/design-research/issues/41). This file does not declare 0.4.0 released.

## Outcome

Every attempted run leaves auditable terminal evidence. Afterward, an explicit opt-in command can aggregate component contributions and persisted analysis results into a clearly labeled partial paper draft.

## Mandatory evidence scope

- Persist a terminal record for successful, failed, and skipped attempts.
- Retain stable IDs, resolved configuration, seeds, prompt lineage, observed activity, raw observations or artifact references, evaluation outputs, failure/skip reasons, attachments, hashes, and redacted runtime provenance where applicable.
- Keep canonical artifact schema 0.2.0 intact; add separately versioned records.
- Make records readable after the originating process terminates.

## Opt-in draft scope

- Own the small versioned `PaperContribution` interchange contract.
- Aggregate component contributions without hard-coding component-specific methodological knowledge.
- Add an explicit API/CLI surface, provisionally `export_paper_draft(...)` and `drexp draft-paper`.
- Generate compilable LaTeX, readable Markdown, curated BibTeX, a paper-draft manifest, explicit TODOs, and linked tables/figures.
- Set `document_status: paper-draft` and `author_review_required: true`.
- Refuse silent citation-key conflicts and silent overwrite of an existing draft.
- Optionally write an honest draft and then exit nonzero under `--require-complete` when evidence-critical TODOs remain.

## Acceptance

- No draft is generated by default.
- A fresh process can build the draft using only the study directory.
- Planned, observed, analyzed, and excluded counts remain distinct.
- The 40/37/3/35/2 negative fixture is rendered accurately.
- Planned-but-unexecuted analysis and configured-but-unused tools become gaps/TODOs.
- Existing study outputs without the new records still load.

## Non-goals

No generated references, automatic scientific interpretation, arbitrary workflow introspection, journal-specific publication template, or automatic paper generation during `run_study`.
